invariants.text: Every epistemic object has stable identity and immutable content; change occurs by supersession.
Canonical history is append-only.
Current epistemic state is derived only from committed transitions.
The neural model may propose transitions but may not authorize, execute, verify its own effects, or commit state.
The Constitutional VM determines transition legality; proposal components cannot self-certify legality.
Authority and execution are separate responsibilities and separate components.
An executor cannot independently certify the resulting external reality of its own effect.
Evidence integrity proof is not semantic truth proof.
Unknown, absent, contradicted, invalidated, expired and false are distinct states.
No high-impact external effect occurs without explicit authority bound to the exact effect.
Consumed authority cannot be resurrected by restart, recovery, compaction or replay.
Replay of the same committed transition history under the same constitutional epoch must reconstruct the same state projection.
Memory indexes and embeddings are derived projections and cannot become canonical state owners.
Language is input/output serialization and cannot be canonical epistemic state.
Alternative search and defeater search produce proposals/evidence only and possess no commit or effect authority.
Missing policy, missing authority, invalid proof or unbound effect cannot silently degrade into permission.
Every material failure mode has an explicit consequence and is represented as testable architecture evidence.
Every canonical responsibility has exactly one owner.
Every canonical owner is declared in the component registry.
Historical defects are retained as adversarial fixtures rather than erased by rewrite.

Caller-supplied authority context is never trusted; positive authority must derive from a cryptographically verified assertion bound to the exact input state and CETA operation plus the Authority Ledger's own state.
An Execute or Rollback transition must durably reserve its exact permit intent before canonical transition commit; no second pending effect may reuse the same permit.
Every adapter invocation and execution receipt is cryptographically bound to the Effect Gateway identity/key, permit, prepared intent, adapter and exact consequence.
External-effect verification requires a signed observation from a configured verifier identity distinct from the executor; executor claims alone cannot establish resulting reality.
Evidence and identity proof registries must survive restart and detect tampering; loss of proof material fails closed rather than reconstructing unsupported trust.
The supervised target transition may define loss but may not be injected into the normal inference candidate set; runtime proposal generation is target-blind.
Training, validation and held-out membership is bound by curriculum manifest, split hashes and structural family assignment rather than by filename.
Every successful governed training call durably commits a checkpoint before returning control to its caller.
Resume authority comes from the append-only training ledger last committed checkpoint; uncommitted optimizer tails are preserved as evidence but explicitly orphaned before replay.
Independent evaluation cannot mutate training state, held-out evaluation cannot authorize promotion, and promotion remains distinct from epoch completion.
Canonical training evidence excludes deployment-location-dependent paths so identical logical runs can reproduce the same evidence root.
